svg.title: Café Étoile — a Penrose rhombus floor
svg.desc: Overhead view of a café with a genuine nonperiodic P3 Penrose tiling, made of edge-matched 36 and 72 degree rhombi. Teal thick rhombi and warm limestone thin rhombi fill the floor between wooden tables, bentwood chairs, windows and an espresso counter.

g.text: Aperiodic rhombus tiling · limestone & glazed teal
